title: Non-numeric, non-entity-id write arguments trace to the input or earlier tool results
objective: Ensure a write tool argument whose value is neither a number nor an entity id traces to the user input or to an earlier tool result, so a write does not act on an invented free-text or structured value.
acceptance_criteria: Scope: runs with write tool calls whose arguments contain a non-numeric, non-entity-id value. Numbers and entity ids stay with T6-002/T6-003, and read-only calls are out of scope. Values the tool schema constrains with enum, const or default are exempt. Pass: every such value appears in the user input or in an earlier tool's arguments or result. Fail: a write argument value cannot be traced there. n/a: no write call carries such a value. The check is opt-in; the traces in the tests are hand-written examples, not observed incidents.
